title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
summary: The top and left boundaries touch the Pacific.

contractDetails.constraints: A rectangular grid with 1–200 rows and columns. Heights are integers from 0 to 100000.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare the full set of zero-based coordinate pairs, rejecting duplicates and allowing any outer order.

statement: The top and left boundaries touch the Pacific. The bottom and right boundaries touch the Atlantic. Water can cross an orthogonal edge from a cell to one of equal or lower height. Return every zero-based [row, column] where water can reach both oceans, in any order.

examples.explanation: The lowest cell can only drain directly to the Pacific.
Every cell touches the top and bottom borders.
Water crosses the whole plateau because equal heights permit movement.

constraints: A rectangular grid with 1–200 rows and columns. Heights are integers from 0 to 100000.
hints: Conceptual: Consider asking which cells can reach an ocean rather than starting a search at each cell.
Directional: Start at the borders for each ocean and reverse the direction of legal moves.
Implementation: Traverse to equal or higher neighbors. Intersect the two visited sets and emit each shared coordinate once.
complexityAnalysis: O(rows × columns) time and space for two traversals.
